title: The Temple, part five: the standing week drawn from the recurring series

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const w=r('lib/sites/temple-week.ts'),h=r('components/sites/house-home.tsx'),s=r('components/sites/house-sections.tsx'),c=r('components/sites/temple-css.ts'),d=r('lib/sites/menswork-data.ts');if(!w.includes('export function templeWeek'))bad.push('templeWeek');if(/day-notes-store|listDayNotes|space_calendar_day_notes/.test(w+h))bad.push('the week reads the team-only day notes');if(!h.includes('templeWeek(')||!h.includes('weekdayOfTitle'))bad.push('house-home does not draw the week');if(!s.includes('hs-week')||!s.includes('hs-day-'))bad.push('no week markup');if(!c.includes('.hs-week')||!c.includes('.hs-day-held'))bad.push('no week skin');if(!d.includes('recurring'))bad.push('events do not say which are recurring');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1297: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Follows LIVE-1296. On a Temple site the Home's steps section draws the design's standing week: seven arch-topped day cards, Monday first, derived from the Space's recurring series for the next four weeks (loadMensworkLive now marks each event recurring). Two series on one weekday that never share a date read 'or' and 'Alternating'; series that land on the same date read 'then' and 'Most Sundays'; one-off events are never drawn. A day with no series is a quiet dashed card; its words come only from the owner's own step cards titled with a weekday ('Friday'), and wording like retreat, rental or held draws the night card. Day notes are NOT read: they are team-only by owner ruling (ADR-1387, migration 20270345005400), which supersedes the 'visibility public' line in the design handoff's IMPLEMENTATION.md.
